items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I took his place in the band

ctx.x: And that's how I learned about making time, which-- I loved Duke, and I had the greatest respect for Duke Ellington, because I thought he was -- well, in fact, not thought, but I think he is the greatest thing that ever lived. Because when I was a kid down in Miami, I used to have my little

crystal set, and I used to hear his band from the Cotton Club, and I always dreamed that one day I'd probably get a chance to play in his band -- which did happen when Louis Bellson went to England to marry Pearl Bailey; I took his place in the band.
Oh, you did? You got a chance to play with him.
